description: DatoCMS is a headless CMS. The `datocms-assets.com` domain is its asset-delivery CDN for uploaded media such as images, PDFs, raw files, and direct MP4 asset URLs.
summary: datocms-assets.com exposes one public HTTP asset-delivery surface: DatoCMS’s asset CDN at `www.datocms-assets.com`, serving original files and URL-parameter image transformations without authentication.
